notes.title: Lotus: Lost Memories launches August 1st for $4.99 USD
notes.content: [h1]The full game is almost here.[/h1][p][/p][p]If you played the demo, you’ve seen Chapter 1 and a portion of Chapter 2. The full release completes the rest of Chapter 2 and delivers the entire Chapter 3. New [b]characters[/b], new [b]locations[/b], and the long-awaited [b]tournament[/b] arc.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301588/bc771f68f9855bb88290a937d5d5b5c9f2c59654.png"][/img][/p][p]Expect around [b]3 hours[/b] of story-rich gameplay, culminating in a [b]cinematic finale[/b] that brings Atsushi’s journey to a close… [i]for now.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301588/1ac3b3d0dc3974e31b800fe97f5d71700b6ee53e.png"][/img][/p][p]Once the story ends, [i]Gauntlet Mode[/i] begins. A pure combat challenge set in the tournament arena featuring an online [b]leaderboard[/b].[/p][p][/p][h1]August 1st. Steam. $4.99. 5pm EST[/h1]

tags.feature: New [b]characters[/b], new [b]locations[/b], and the long-awaited [b]tournament[/b] arc.
Once the story ends, [i]Gauntlet Mode[/i] begins. A pure combat challenge set in the tournament arena featuring an online [b]leaderboard[/b].

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Out Now!
notes.content: [h1]What’s in the Demo?[/h1][p][b]Play through the opening chapter[/b] (20–30 minutes of gameplay)[/p][p][b]Fight in three turn-based combat encounters[/b], including the bandit leader mini-boss[/p][p][b]Meet key characters[/b] like Master Osamu, Etienne, and Lord Hironori[/p][p][b]Begin Atsushi’s story[/b], setting the stage for deeper mysteries ahead[/p][p][b]Experience a grounded mix of visual novel storytelling and strategic combat[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/HTjNh4EyPD" style="button"]discord[/url] to leave feedback![/p]
